•Third and most challenging, you need to transform the lifeless, desolate and frozen wasteland into a new home for Mankind. You will do this from scratch, using constructed tools, machinery, and Earth born bacteria and plant life carefully nurtured and strategically placed. notes.content:
[h1] Fixed discovery of crash sites achievements[/h1] 

[h1]Added adapter ID to config.ini file. [/h1]

	Syntax: 
	Adapter=X 
	Where X is the monitors adapter ordinal, (0 for single monitor systems)

	On 4gig PCs, the memory usage was pretty tight. 
	Any deviation from a bare bones system would result in page faults, resulting in game stuttering. 

[h1]Changed player position icon in the GPS dialog to be an arrow.[/h1] 

[h1] FPS Performance[/h1] 
	2 things: 
	The 3d animations are being performed on the GPU as opposed to the CPU. 
	The ROAM modeling and horizon filter have been replaced with a region elimination algorithm. 

-[h1]Releasing the core[/h1] 
	There are now surface features that allow the player to easily find these iron fingers. 
	Previous versions the iron fingers had to be 'melted' at a depth of 32 (surface being 96), 
	so this was a lot of digging. 
	If these iron fingers are 'melted at depth 64, this will now release the core.

[h1] Rain cycle fixes: [/h1]

	- Elevation is now included in the chances to rain calculation, higher elevations will now get less rain. 

[h1] Core/mantel temperatures have been changed.[/h1] 
 -They now reflect the values specified in the PlanetDef.ini file. 


[h1] Melt the ice cap achievement has been fixed.[/h1] 

[h1]Plant decals now use the same blending as block to block blends,[/h1] 
	some users were seeing black as the background, this should be fixed. 

[h1] Cosmetic changes in the tooltip dialog and the message area.[/h1]

[I] I've been asked a number of times, what made you decide to write this game?[/I]

I'll try to explain myself:
My son turned me on to 'Dwarf Fortress', at the same time I was working on a point cloud re-engineer project.
For the project I was using a marching cubes alg. over a convex hull voxel set. 
It occurred to me that all I needed to do was add this a marching cube alg. over 'Dwarf Fortress' and just like that I'd have a 3D version.
In my spare time, I fiddled on this for awhile, but, the 3D performance was never going to happen, 
unless I could get under the covers of the code.
And, I kind of got bored w/ 'Dwarf Fortress', too.
Ever since I was a kid, reading science fiction, the idea of terraforming Mars has been very interesting to me.
(What a geek)
One day it occurred to me, I could use this 'Dwarf Fortress' code and use it on top of a 'Mars simulation', I'd have a game.
So that's what I did, the more I did, the more fun it was for me, friends and relatives to play it.
I said 'what the heck', lets try to make this a commercial game, there must be other 'geeks' out there?

notes.title: Halloween Updates 10/27/14
notes.content:
Centuries of misuse and neglect have transformed our home world into a blistered ruin. In desperation, the dwindling resources of all mankind are pooled together one last time.  Three terraforming ships set forth towards Mars, the ancient deity of War, of blood. Of our final hope. As they begin their approach to the red planet a blinding light erupts from behind the moon Deimos, and the last chance for the human race plummets to the arms of the awaiting God. 

Beware: someone, something brought those ships down.

 You will create a complete atmosphere, hydrosphere, and a complex biosphere - step by agonizing step - as you fight to stave off the cold, the hunger, and the loneliness of a world that will kill you without a thought, with no one to hear you scream.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[b]Aliens[/b]
- Rendering aliens after world wrap.
- Alien AI is slightly better.
	- Aliens will avoid jumping over one another
	- Aliens will avoid jumping on top of the player
	- Aliens will try to take an alternate path to the player, if any obstruction is in the way, 
	- Aliens no longer deal each other damage.
	- Aliens will die if exposed to extreme temperatures

[b]Temperature[/b]
	- The conversion from internal units to actual temperatures has been changed
	- This change allows for a wider temperature range
	- And allows for more accurate state changes,
	- Example: Basalt to lava now takes place at 700c

[b]Door placement orientation[/b]

[b]Heating[/b]
- Interior heating is slower and consumes less fuel
- Inaccurate temperature readings after a players movement in interior places

[b]Battery[/b]
	- Battery capacity is doubled
	- But degradation is based on power use
	- So, both the light and heater will consume battery
	- But, if you turn off the light, battery degrading will slow
	- The battery degrading w/o the light on equals old degrading
	- So keep the light turned off as much as possible.

[b]Evaporation uses different logic[/b]
	- Inverse pressure times inverse humidity times temperature gives the likelihood of any 'sun lit' water block to evaporate.

[b]Rain uses different logic[/b]
	- Pressure times humidity gives the likelihood of any cloud block to rain.
	- There is a low and high water mark for clouds
	- Once the high water mark is reached, it will start to rain
	- Once raining, once the low water mark is reached, raining will stop

[b]Some small performance improvements[/b]
